entities.name: Fall of Kroog
entities.description: Surprise attack by the Fallaji Empire that took Kroog in a single morning.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: Capital of Yotia, attacked by the Fallaji Empire.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Led the charge atop Traxos and was appointed the new Qadir.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Wandering the desert, unaware of the siege.

entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Urza's pregnant wife, queen presiding over Kroog.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Set up avengers in the palace and helped Kayla escape.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Freed by Tawnos, she kills the Qadir with the Staff of Zegon.

entities.name: Staff of Zegon
entities.description: Staff Ashnod used to drain life.

entities.name: Rica
entities.description: Avenger pilot who escaped to Hench.

entities.name: Sanwell
entities.description: Avenger pilot who escaped to Hench.

entities.name: Rendall
entities.description: Ornithopter pilot sent east with the Jalum Tome.

entities.name: Aiman
entities.description: Injured, half-blinded Fallaji foot soldier who survived.

events.summary: Four months after the failed Peace Talks, the Fallaji strike and Kroog falls in a single morning.
events.quote: Four months after the failed Peace Talks at Kroog , the Fallaji struck, and the fall of the city happened in a single morning.

events.summary: Tawnos sets up five avengers with pilots and sends the Jalum Tome east with Rendall.
events.quote: He then sent the Jalum Tome with the ornithopter pilot Rendall to the east.

events.summary: The avengers are overwhelmed by dragon engines; Carlo and others die while Sanwell and Rica escape to Hench.
events.quote: while Sanwell and Rica managed to escape to Hench.

events.summary: Tawnos frees Ashnod and returns the Staff of Zegon on condition she protect the pregnant queen.
events.quote: was let free by Tawnos and given the Staff of Zegon back on the premise that she protected the pregnant queen.

events.summary: Ashnod knocks out the Qadir's guards and kills the Qadir by draining his life with the staff.
events.quote: The Qadir himself she made sure to kill, draining his life with the staff such that he collapsed, bleeding.

events.summary: Ashnod helps Tawnos and Kayla escape by boat and returns to Mishra.
events.quote: Ashnod then made sure Tawnos and Kayla escaped the burning city in a boat headed downriver towards the sea

events.summary: Mishra is appointed the new Qadir.
events.quote: Mishra was appointed the new Qadir in the wake of the city's fall.

relations.quote: while his pregnant wife, Queen Kayla bin-Kroog presided over the city.

relations.note: drained his life with the Staff of Zegon
relations.quote: The Qadir himself she made sure to kill
while she went back to rejoin Mishra.
